title: Hubitat Event Action Duration Leaderboard
dataSources: Home Assistant state/logbook events (`homeassistant:event`), Homey flow/insights (`homey:flow`), SmartThings events (`smartthings:event`), Hubitat/openHAB logs, Node-RED flow events (`nodered:event`).
app: Home Assistant / Homey / SmartThings / Hubitat / openHAB event streams via MQTT, webhooks, and REST — forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hubitat:event duration_ms=*
| stats sum(duration_ms) as total_value, avg(duration_ms) as avg_value by app_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks app values by total and average action duration across Hubitat event events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `duration_ms` values for each Hubitat event event and review total and average action duration by app.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total action duration.
grandmaExplanation: It estimates which app shows the biggest action duration numbers in your Hubitat event data.
